identity.notes: Star Island is a small (0.134 sq mi), exclusive man-made residential island in the City of Miami Beach, completed in 1922 by the Army Corps of Engineers and initially owned by developer Carl Fisher. It features approximately 30–35 single-family waterfront estates (fixed supply of ~35 lots), is accessible by a single guard-gated bridge via the MacArthur Causeway, and is part of the Biscayne Bay Aquatic Preserve. Per Bloomberg, it is the most expensive neighborhood in the U.S. The Palm Hibiscus Star Islands Association (est. 04/23/1998; property manager FPMS, Sarasota FL, 941-960-5000; board address 152 Palm Avenue, Miami Beach, FL 33139; association records list 255 Palm Ave) supports security, landscaping, and community upkeep across Star, Palm, and Hibiscus Islands.

fees.note: Traditional monthly or quarterly HOA dues are not applicable; residents contribute to shared security and maintenance. Specific fee amounts and structures are not publicly detailed in available sources.
